briefings.title: Fireside Chat with Mark Moffat, CEO of IFS | RAISE Summit 2026
briefings.tldr: IFS CEO Mark Moffat and Bank of America Managing Director Thomas Köhrer discussed how industrial AI is transforming asset-heavy, mission-critical sectors like manufacturing, aerospace, and utilities, emphasizing that true deployment requires a balance of probabilistic AI reasoning and deterministic safety standards where failure is not an option.

briefings.title: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan Talks Trading Revenue, AI Safety | Bloomberg Talks
briefings.tldr: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan expects third-quarter trading revenue to be relatively flat compared to an exceptionally strong prior year, while warning that the rapid pace of artificial intelligence development requires deliberate safety guardrails and careful corporate deployment.

briefings.title: Inside Bank of America: Brian Moynihan on Leadership, AI and Global Growth

people.name: Brian Moynihan
people.role: Chair of the Board & CEO, Bank of America

briefings.tldr: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan highlights the resilience of the American consumer and small businesses despite K-shaped economic pressures, while detailing the bank's disciplined approach to AI implementation and global sports investments.
